taskPrompt: For an Account update, list every automation that runs, the order it runs in, and every record each one writes or references.
startingPoint: Account object in Setup with source metadata only, before any deployment or execution.

expansionProfile.notes: Single-level references; one inactive flow and one dynamic SOQL.

inclusionRationale: Robustness scenario: adds an inactive (Draft) flow the tool must exclude and a dynamic SOQL targeting Opportunity the tool must leave unresolved, alongside a static cross-object write to Case, to exercise the uncertainty regime rather than only fully-resolvable structure.
notes: Account update robustness case: trigger split before/after with a dependency class and a dynamic Opportunity SOQL; before-save and after-save flows; one Draft (inactive) flow; one validation rule.
